scope: Fresh rebuild of the final pruned seven-library tree and seven offline usage checks, plus existing local libfixmath/libfixmatrix dependencies.
configuration: CMake MinSizeRel, GCC -Os -DNDEBUG, C_STANDARD=99, C_EXTENSIONS=OFF, -pedantic-errors; tests use explicit checks not disabled by NDEBUG

tests.name: control_extra.fusion
tests.stdout: Fusion: stationary/90-degree synthetic IMU and calibration passed

tests.name: control_extra.pid
tests.stdout: PID: plant/clamps/no kick plus derivative step decay and unit-ramp regression passed

tests.name: control_extra.canard
tests.stdout: libcanard: classic CAN single/multiframe, duplicate/CRC rejection, allocation cleanup passed

tests.name: control_extra.nanomodbus
tests.stdout: nanoMODBUS: in-memory TCP holding-register response and exception passed

tests.name: control_extra.coremqtt
tests.stdout: coreMQTT: MQTT5 QoS1 byte vector/round trip, ping, short buffers passed

tests.name: control_extra.lwip
tests.stdout: lwIP: IPv4/IPv6 UDP and IPv4 TCP raw API loopback passed without NIC/OS sockets

size_definition: Actual unstripped .a file bytes, plus sum of GNU size text/data/bss across archive members; excludes libc/libm and existing dependency archives. Values are for Linux x86_64 and this release profile only. BSS is zero-initialized runtime storage, not bytes stored in the archive; heap/stack usage can be additional.

not_run.scope: Other CPUs, compilers, OSes and real sensor/actuator/CAN/Ethernet/serial hardware
not_run.reason: Only Linux x86_64 was available; portable/core and existing platform source retained, not hardware-qualified.

not_run.scope: MQTT broker integration, full MQTT5/QoS state-machine scenario matrix
not_run.reason: This check exercises serializer byte vectors, round-trip parsing, malformed input and buffer limits without a broker.

not_run.scope: DNS/DHCP/AutoIP/IGMP/MLD/DHCPv6 network exchanges and IPv6 TCP wire behavior
not_run.reason: Compiled in lwIP; runtime check covers IPv4/IPv6 UDP and IPv4 TCP loopback only.

not_run.scope: Complete upstream regression suites, CBMC proofs and static analysis
not_run.reason: Original test/example source is retained for further work. Full external development harnesses were not imported or run; in particular libcanard upstream development instructions require Unity, 32-bit C/C++20 matrix, clang-tidy, cppcheck and clang-format, which this environment does not provide. This is a collection integration check, not a claim of passing that upstream gate.

source_integrity: All retained vendor files match pinned downloaded bytes. A single reviewed PID derivative-feedback sign correction is generated into the build tree; PID_FIX.md describes it and the original-fails/corrected-passes regression.

pid_regression.status: PASS with generated correction; original vendor reproduction fails as expected
